prompt.project_info: Create a realistic candid café study photograph using the attached approved-adult face reference.
prompt.main_subject: The original approved adult woman from the attached reference sits at a wooden café table, leaning forward slightly while writing in an open workbook. She has a low messy ponytail with loose strands, thin metal-frame glasses, and wears an oversized light beige or off-white hoodie. Her head is tilted toward the notebook rather than the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium shot slightly above table level, one hand holding a pen and the other resting on papers, open notebooks with handwritten notes, printed study sheets, scattered pens, two minimalist takeaway coffee cups, wireless earbuds case, smartphone face-up, warm café counter, wooden furniture, hanging plants, and coffee equipment.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm ambient pendant lighting with soft indoor shadows, calm focused study atmosphere, gentle background blur, natural café realism and quiet productivity.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone-photo feel, medium candid framing, slightly above table-level angle, shallow depth of field, natural texture, subtle grain, warm restrained color grade, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic candid café study photograph of the original approved adult woman from the attached face reference seated at a wooden table and leaning forward while writing in an open workbook. Preserve her face, facial structure, and identity. She wears an oversized light beige hoodie, thin metal-frame glasses, and a low messy ponytail with loose strands; her head is tilted toward the notebook. Open notebooks, study sheets, pens, two minimalist takeaway coffee cups, wireless earbuds case, and a face-up smartphone sit on the table. Warm pendant lights, wooden furniture, café counter, hanging plants, and soft background blur create a calm focused productivity scene.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, unreadable text, random logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

assets.name: approved adult study subject face reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult face, facial structure, identity, glasses, and hair without celebrity or public-figure substitution.

assets.name: warm café study environment reference
assets.usage: Match the café table, workbook, coffee cups, plants, pendant lights, and warm candid composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required adult face reference and café environment reference; they may be the same image. Preserve identity, outfit, study props, environment, lighting, and composition. Notebook text, logos, product packaging, typography, and decorative elements are replaceable editable placeholders.

changes: Replaced exact-face wording with approved-adult identity-reference instructions.
Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the focused study concept.
Added replaceable typography guidance and anti-slop exclusions.
